seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed for reproducible generation. Range: 0-2147483647

image.title: Image
image.description: Optional first-frame image to animate into a video (jpg/png/bmp/webp, ≤10MB). When provided, the video is generated from this image guided by the prompt.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Duration of the generated video in seconds

aspect_ratio.title: aspect_ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video. 'adaptive' lets the model choose the best ratio for the prompt. Ignored when an image is provided (the input image's aspect ratio is used).

negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt
negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt — describes content that should not appear in the video

enable_prompt_expansion.title: Enable Prompt Expansion
enable_prompt_expansion.description: Automatically expand and optimize the prompt for better results. Improves quality for short prompts but increases latency.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: A text description of the image you want to generate

image_input.title: Image Input
image_input.description: Input images to transform or use as reference (supports up to 14 images)

aspect_ratio.title: aspect_ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image

safety_filter_level.title: safety_filter_level
safety_filter_level.description: block_low_and_above is strictest, block_medium_and_above blocks some prompts, block_only_high is most permissive but some prompts will still be blocked

allow_fallback_model.title: Allow Fallback Model
allow_fallback_model.description: Fallback to another model (currently bytedance/seedream-5) if Nano Banana Pro is at capacity.

images.title: Images
images.description: Up to 10 reference images the prompt edits or draws from. When present, the request runs as an edit and the first image drives 'auto' aspect ratio. Each image must be at least 256x256 px and at most 16 MP. Must be jpeg, png, gif, or webp.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate, or of the edit to apply to the reference images.

grounding.title: Grounding
grounding.description: Let the model research the prompt with web search and image search before generating.

resolution.title: resolution
resolution.description: Resolution of the output image. Input images are resized to the closest bin, up to 2k.

aspect_ratio.title: aspect_ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image. 'auto' picks the ratio from the prompt and the first reference image.

output_quality.title: Output Quality
output_quality.description: Quality when saving the output images, from 0 to 100. 100 is best quality, 0 is lowest quality. Not relevant for .png outputs

safety_tolerance.title: Safety Tolerance
safety_tolerance.description: Moderation tolerance for inputs and outputs. 0 is the strictest, 4 is the most permissive.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: A text description of the image you want to generate

resolution.title: resolution
resolution.description: Resolution of the generated image. Higher resolutions take longer to generate.

image_input.title: Image Input
image_input.description: Input images to transform or use as reference (supports up to 14 images)

aspect_ratio.title: aspect_ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image

image_search.title: Image Search
image_search.description: Use Google Image Search grounding to find web images as visual context for generation. When enabled, web search is also used automatically.

google_search.title: Google Search
google_search.description: Use Google Web Search grounding to generate images based on real-time information (e.g. weather, sports scores, recent events).
